raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "have"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "a cow of 7 years"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "have"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "a calf"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "have"
    role subject ?x
    role object "cows"
    polarity affirmed
  end
  where match
    relation "be on"
    role subject ?x
    role location "Poienile de sub Munte"
    polarity affirmed
  end
